title: The Fleet lens serves zero records while Samsara answers with 75, because the record-shape guard enforces the very taxonomy the module it lives in says it refuses to impose
whatThisRowActuallyNeeded: Not a build. The fix was already merged as PR #77 (03e11b0b). The remaining act was the manual redeploy of dolphin-app, because deploy_on_push is unset and a merge ships nothing. That is the act performed here.

deployed.readBack: services[0].source_commit_hash === 0848dd7286db61e74a07ffe7ac4e9a1d30a4b547, compared byte for byte against git ls-remote of the branch

acceptance.clause: the fleet-vehicle region renders at least one real Samsara record with a `status` that came from the vendor rather than from this product's taxonomy, OR the guard is corrected to the vendor's actual shape and the region's `recordCount` is greater than zero with the basis still naming what was refused; and the fix does not force-map raw telemetry onto VEHICLE_STATUS_VALUES
acceptance.result: MET, on the second branch of the OR

evidence.route: GET https://app.smartcityos.io/api/domains/fleet-vehicles?cityKey=bastrop_tx with the G-135 lane-verification identity

before.basis: samsara answered and every one of the 75 fleet-vehicle records it returned was refused by the record-shape guard: status must be one of out-of-service, inspection-due, in-shop, in-service; fleet-vehicle requires operatorRef; fleet-vehicle requires odometerBand

after.countingRule: 72 real fleet-vehicle records read live from smartcity-os for bastrop_tx

refusalsStillNamed.extras.refusals: three recordIds, each with its fault; the odometerless records are refused BY NAME on purpose

noForceMapping.perRecordExplanation: each record carries its own statusBasis, that the read reports no engine state for that vehicle; so raw telemetry was not mapped onto VEHICLE_STATUS_VALUES

acceptance.predictionConfirmed: The row's own post-deploy expectation, written before the deploy, was 'most of the 75 paint, and the 3 with no odometer stay REFUSED BY NAME on purpose'. Observed: 72 painted, 3 refused by name. The prediction is the falsifier and it held.
